customManagers.description: ARC Helm charts are OCI refs consumed as a plain Ansible variable (kubernetes.core.helm chart_ref/chart_version), not a Chart.yaml/values.yaml Renovate's native Helm managers scan. Tracked against the GitHub release tag both charts share (gha-runner-scale-set-<version>).
Helm CLI static release, installed by github_runner_arc rather than a package manager.

Single org-wide Cribl version, consumed by cribl_stream, cribl_edge and cribl_docker_stack via cribl_version rather than each declaring its own pin. Tracked against Cribl's published Docker tags. Unlike Technitium, a bump here is self-healing: roles/cribl_stream/tasks/mirror_seed.yml re-seeds and re-checksums the object-storage mirror on every converge, so no block-major rule is needed.

packageRules.description: The object-storage engine has published only pre-1.0 releases, so every version is flagged unstable and the default suppresses all of them. The pin therefore never moved while its annotation claimed it was tracked here, and it sat four releases behind with no update ever proposed. Follow unstable for this package until it ships a stable release.
OpenProject AIO majors need a deliberate sequential upgrade + bundled Postgres data migration (see #928). Block automatic major bumps; minor/patch still flow.

Technitium is mirror-hosted, so a version bump alone is inert-to-broken: Renovate cannot re-seed the object-storage tarball, re-checksum it, or move the .NET runtime pin when a major changes target framework (15.x is net10.0, 14.x was net9.0). A major landed unattended once and left the pins pointing at a 404. Block major bumps so they stay operator-driven per the re-seed note in roles/technitium_install/defaults/main.yml; minor/patch still flow.
